title: RallyAI Replay
description: One run, start to termination. Self-contained by default: a saved replay embeds its stage so it is the only artifact needed to reproduce the run visually. A live stream is the same format with the stage sent once and frames appended — a replay that has not finished being written.

oneOf.title: Referenced: stage fetched by id, hash-verified

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical serialisation with this field removed. Stamped on write by contracts.write_json; lets a replay prove it has not been edited since it was recorded.

stage.description: The stage inline. Preferred for saved replays.

stage_ref.description: Pointer to a stage the reader already has. content_hash is mandatory: playing frames against a stage that has since changed is exactly the silent desync this field exists to prevent.

dt.description: Fixed timestep between frames, seconds. Physics is fixed-step; this is not a hint.

termination.description: Why the run ended. 'stuck' and 'spun' exist so a dead episode ends instead of burning the step budget.

physics_version.description: Vendored dynamics revision, so a replay can be matched to the model that produced it.

checkpoint.description: Policy checkpoint path, when source is agent or eval.

policy_hash.description: Hash of the weights that drove this run.

clean.description: Finished with no obstacle contact and no time off-course.

frames.description: One entry per fixed step. Keys are short because they repeat thousands of times; every one is documented here.

z.description: Height. Above the road surface when airborne.

vz.description: Vertical velocity — drives the jump/landing read.

sa.description: Chassis slip angle, radians. The opposite-lock tell.

in.description: Commanded inputs, post rate-limit, as the physics saw them.

w.description: Per-wheel state, order FL, FR, RL, RR.

grip.description: Fraction of the combined-slip friction budget in use, 0..1+.

air.description: Airborne. Friction is gated off while true.

hgt.description: Height above the road surface, metres.

mu.description: Effective friction under the car this frame.

s.description: Arc length along the centerline, metres.

lat.description: Signed lateral offset from the centerline, positive right.

fx.description: Continuous effect intensities, 0..1. Discrete one-shots live in the top-level events array instead.

note.description: Pace call active this frame, if any.

events.description: Sparse one-shots. Kept out of frames because they fire rarely and bloat every frame if inlined.
